After the rebellion of Ivar the Uncrowned reaches its pinnacle in a devastating siege on Estor's capital city, Terraven, the kingdom suffers a great political blow as many nations secede. Estor maintains its holdings on the north and east sides of the continent, but Escarth becomes home to many new nations. Calixos, a monarchy southeast of Estor, New Praetoria, a republic based in the south, Arkonia, a monarchy along the west side of the Warming River, and the Freehold, an empire on the west coast. Political ties between Estor and its neighbors are tense, and war between Adrithyr and Arkonia continues in a stalemate for the long winter.
